context: Worker pool that runs a slice of tasks concurrently and collects errors. Used at startup to initialize subsystems in parallel.
explanation: wg.Add(1) is called inside the goroutine instead of before launching it — the main goroutine can reach wg.Wait() before any child has called Add, causing Wait to return immediately with work still in flight. Fix: move wg.Add(1) before the go statement so the WaitGroup count is incremented before the goroutine is scheduled.
